base_member_text: fdir (L2) is a hardcoded developer path while dep comes from the repo-relative path (L4); the two data sources must correspond to the same run for the masking at L27 to be valid.
audit_member_text: Portability defect at L2 and L25: eta files are read from a developer-specific absolute directory, with no runtime input or existence check.

base_member_text: caxis([-0.1 0.1]) (L33) is immediately overridden by the if/else at L36-L40 every iteration, so it is dead code.
audit_member_text: The caxis call at L33 is unconditionally overwritten for every iteration by L36-L40, so its [-0.1,0.1] setting is ineffective.

base_member_text: The mapping nfile=[2 9] to hours {'1' '8'} (L13-L14) implies snapshot k corresponds to (k-1) hours, i.e. a 3600 s output interval; this must match the case input, not verifiable here.

audit_member_text: Cross-array shape assumption at L4-L10 and L25-L31: eta is indexed by a mask derived from dep and plotted on dep-derived coordinates without checking that their dimensions match.

The independent arrays nfile and hr at L13-L14 are indexed by the same num at L24 and L34 but their equal lengths are not checked; editing only one produces an out-of-range hr access or unlabeled selections.
MATLAB pcolor at L31 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present if full-grid coverage is intended.
